summary: Focused frontend retest of the /events/ sub-app (https://chef-tasks.preview.emergentagent.com/events/) after adding the missing `{currentScreen === 'events' && ...}` render branch. MAIN FIX CONFIRMED: EventsScreen now mounts — the content area is NO LONGER blank for admin/holding. Verified with groupenaga@gmail.com: (1) after LOGIN the Événements header + '+' + Archives + empty-state 'Aucun événement. Créez votre premier événement !' render (screen renders, but data is missing — see remaining 401 race); (2) after RELOAD (session-restore path via fetchUserData with explicit token) the real event 'Nouvel an — jeu. 31 déc. 2026' renders and ALL calls are 200 (/auth/me, /categories/list, /users/list, /events, /prestataires/list, /restaurants/my-restaurants) with ZERO console errors — state persists, no blank flash; (3) ☰ > Événement re-fetch = 200 /events + 200 /prestataires/list, 'Nouvel an' visible; (4) restaurant switch Le Cercle -> O'Parloir (11 calls all 200, empty state, correct branding) -> back to Le Cercle ('Nouvel an' restored) — switch flow OK; (5) ☰ > Prestataires renders the Prestataires screen with its empty state, 200 /prestataires/list, no 401 banner; (6) event detail (click 'Nouvel an') opens with the 3 tabs (Prestataires/Tâches/Menu) and all 6 /events/{id}/* endpoints return 200. TWO DEFECTS REMAIN: the login-path token race (401 on /events + /prestataires/list) and a COMPLETELY BLANK screen for the staff account tharshikan@orange.fr (403 on /events, hasEventsAccess() false, no fallback screen).

minor.issue: 401 only on the login path (missing Authorization header, frontend defect). 403 'Permission denied' for staff tharshikan@orange.fr — backend behaviour looks intentional, but the frontend has no handling for it.
403 'Permission denied - menu_groupe.actif required' is requested at login by the events app for staff users — unnecessary call in this sub-app.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: content area is 100% BLANK for the staff account (body text = '☰ ⚙️' only, no restaurant picker, no screen). Root cause: currentScreen defaults to 'events' but hasEventsAccess() returns false (backend returns 403 on /events + /prestataires/list for this user) so the new render branch is skipped and NO other branch matches -> empty <View>. Needs either a 'Accès refusé / aucun module disponible' fallback screen or a default redirect to the first screen the user can access.

After LOGIN (not reload) the screen shows the empty state 'Aucun événement. Créez votre premier événement !' although Le Cercle has the event 'Nouvel an'. Console: 'Error loading events: Error: Not authenticated' + 'Error loading prestataires: ...'. Cause: /app/apps/neochef-events/app/index.tsx L1159/L1161 in LoginScreen.onLogin call loadEvents()/loadPrestataires() with NO token, and apiRequest() reads the sessionToken state which is still null in that tick. The fetchUserData (reload) path is fixed, the login path is not.
ui_bugs.selector: text=Aucun événement. Créez votre premier événement !

ui_bugs.issue: A failed (401/403) events or prestataires fetch is silently swallowed and rendered as an empty state — the user cannot distinguish 'no data' from 'request failed'. Add an error banner + retry.

integration_issues.issue: 401 on /api/events and /api/prestataires/list on every login (reproduced 3/3 runs). Fix: loadEvents(token)/loadPrestataires(token) optional token param like loadCategories/loadUsers, or a tokenRef read inside apiRequest.
403 on /events and /prestataires/list -> blank app shell, no message, staff is stuck (no bottom nav, no accessible screen).

issues: Fully empty beige content area with only the ☰ and ⚙️ icons in the header — no message, no way forward.
Restaurant picker affordance is a tiny 'v' chip next to the logo; low discoverability (minor).

data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity (login-button, manager-menu-button, menu-item-events...) are NOT emitted in the DOM, so automation must rely on text selectors (known/out-of-scope per request).

action_items: HIGH: pass the token explicitly on the login path — /app/apps/neochef-events/app/index.tsx L1159/L1161: loadEvents(token) / loadPrestataires(token) (add an optional token param exactly like loadCategories/loadUsers), or store the token in a ref read by apiRequest. Currently every login shows an empty events list.

CRITICAL: add a fallback render branch when no currentScreen branch matches (e.g. 'Vous n'avez accès à aucun module de cette application') — a staff user without the events permission currently sees a totally blank app.
MEDIUM: surface fetch errors in the Événements/Prestataires screens (error banner + retry) instead of falling back to the empty state.
MINOR: don't call /group-reservations/list from the events sub-app at login (403 for staff).
Rebuild + re-assemble /app/frontend/build/events after the above fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: The token race was only fixed in fetchUserData; the LoginScreen.onLogin callback (L1155-1162) still calls loadEvents()/loadPrestataires() without a token — same class of bug, same tick problem. Move the token to a ref (tokenRef.current) inside apiRequest to eliminate the whole family of races across the 3 apps.
The render tree has no default/else branch: any currentScreen value whose gate evaluates false yields an empty View. Add an explicit fallback.
app/index.tsx is ~9.7k lines; per-screen modules would have made the missing-render-branch bug obvious.

success_rate.frontend: 80% - 4/6 scenarios pass (reload persistence, menu navigation, restaurant switch both ways, prestataires screen, event detail); FAIL: login-path data load (401 -> empty state) and staff user (blank screen)

test_credentials: groupenaga@gmail.com / LeCercle123! (holding, works). tharshikan@orange.fr / Kajan1012 (staff, login works but events app renders blank due to 403/permissions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: EventsScreen render branch is confirmed present in the deployed bundle (entry-796b45e6...js) and mounts correctly. Login on /events/ via text selectors only (data-testid is stripped by RN-Web): click text 'Connexion' -> fill input[0]/input[1] -> click 'Se connecter'. Header ☰ opens the manager menu (Menu Groupe / Événement / Facturation / Prestataires); the 'v' chip next to the logo opens the restaurant picker. Remaining to verify after fixes: (a) events visible IMMEDIATELY after login (no reload), (b) non-blank screen for the staff account, (c) create/edit/delete event CRUD (not yet exercised).
rca_of_the_issue: Blank /events/ screen had two causes; the missing `{currentScreen === 'events' && ...}` render branch (fixed, verified) and the token race (fixed only for the reload/fetchUserData path). A third, distinct blank-screen case remains for staff users: currentScreen defaults to 'events', hasEventsAccess() is false (backend 403 on /events), no other branch matches and there is no fallback, so an empty View is rendered.
